name: Protection from Aberrations
body:
School abjuration; Level sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell wards a creature from attacks by creatures with the aberration type. First, against attacks made by aberrations, the subject gains a +2 deflection bonus to AC and a +2 resistance bonus on saves. Next, the subject becomes immune to any effects caused by an aberration that can be removed by remove disease or remove curse. Lastly, the subject immediately receives another save against spells or effects originating from an aberration that attempts to gain mental control over the creature, with a +2 moral bonus.
